rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the vidyā
qualifies vidyā as having sixteen parts or syllables
technical term for a sacred formula or knowledge
instrumental compound indicating cause or basis of variation
past passive participle indicating presentation or teaching

items.question: By what doctrinal difference is this sixteenfold vidyā shown to vary?
premises: This vidyā is characterized as sixteenfold.
The vidyā is presented as having been shown.
Its presentation varies according to differences in doctrine.
items.inference: Therefore, the sixteenfold vidyā is taught in different forms across doctrines.
items.plain_english: This sixteenfold vidyā is indeed shown according to differences in doctrine.
